title: School Vouchers & Public Education Funding
question_text: The government should fund K-12 education by...

stances.text: Fully funding public schools and eliminating voucher programs that divert taxpayer money to private institutions
Prioritizing public school funding while restricting vouchers to low-income families who lack adequate local options
Funding public schools at current levels while allowing means-tested voucher programs with accountability requirements for participating private schools
Expanding voucher eligibility to most families so parents can choose the school that best fits their child, while maintaining baseline public school funding
Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family

discovery.policy_lever: State legislature controls voucher eligibility, K-12 funding formula, and per-pupil allocation
